# Skill: Pathway Workspace Mapping

## When To Use

Use when assigning LOTM pathways to Hyprland workspaces and UI identity.

## Recipe

1. Define a small starter set (3-5 pathways), not all 22 at once.
2. Map each to one workspace and one practical role.
3. Generate workspace metadata once in Nix.
4. Emit normalized runtime data for Quickshell.
5. Animate only active and adjacent workspaces.

## Guardrails

- Avoid displaying all pathway icons simultaneously.
- Keep icon usage semantic, not decorative.
- Prefer low-opacity watermarks over high-contrast overlays.

## Done Condition

- Workspace switch clearly changes identity.
- Mapping is declarative and easy to extend.
